item.title: Homes.com metrics climb as CoStar profit slides in 2025
item.description: Homes.com traffic hit 100 million average monthly visitors in 2025, as CoStar net income fell to $7 million on acquisition costs.

item.title: Retirement planning faces longevity risk as Americans live longer
item.description: PLANADVISER outlines the steps that retirement plan sponsors and financial advisers should take with their clients given the need for longevity. Reverse mortgage professionals should be aware of these details as they incorporate home equity-based funding solutions into retirement plans.

item.title: Northeast gains leverage as Sun Belt markets slow
item.description: U.S. housing metrics are rising YoY, but metro absorption gaps are widening. Northeast markets favor sellers, while Florida and Texas favor buyers.

item.description: Addy AI integrates with ICE Encompass, adding AI checklists, plain-language findings and trackable document requests to reduce work.

item.description: Debbie Baum is joining Brown Harris Stevens, after her Corcoran team posted $27.28 million in 2024 sales volume.

item.title: How one Florida community transformed hurricane resilience into record sales
item.description: Babcock Ranch logged 1,066 net sales in 2025, up 34%, even as housing demand in Southwest Florida weakened.

item.title: Housing leaders say Trump’s plan must go deeper than lower mortgage rates
item.description: Industry leaders said Trump’s address left housing affordability largely unaddressed, with more focus on tariffs and investor restrictions.

item.title: Rental vacancy data shows progress that can keep mortgage rates lower
item.description: Rental vacancy is 7.2% and homeowner vacancy is 1.2%, supporting shelter disinflation and steadier mortgage rates.
